existing_features.title: Update the unauthenticated landing screen UI to show two distinct primary actions—one button labeled "Sign Up" and a second button labeled "Log In"—instead of the single combined "Sign Up / Log In" button.

Ensure loading/disabled behavior is correct when authentication is in progress: when a user clicks either "Sign Up" or "Log In", both buttons are disabled while `loginStatus === 'logging-in'`, and the UI provides clear feedback that a connection is in progress.

new_feature_requests.summary: Update auth UI to have separate buttons for Sign up and Log in (instead of a combined button).

projectName: Separate Sign Up and Log In buttons on the authentication screen
